mcqs.question: Which of the following best defines a quadrilateral?

options.C: A shape with two pairs of parallel sides
options.D: A shape with all sides equal

mcqs.explanation: A quadrilateral is a polygon that has exactly four straight sides. Option B states this definition. Option A describes a triangle, while C and D describe specific types of quadrilaterals but not the general definition.

mcqs.learning_point: Identify sides, vertices and angles of quadrilaterals
mcqs.question: How many sides, vertices, and interior angles does a quadrilateral have?
mcqs.explanation: By definition, a quadrilateral has four sides, each meeting at a vertex, giving four vertices, and consequently four interior angles. Option B correctly lists these counts. The other options describe polygons with a different number of sides or an impossible combination.

mcqs.question: Which quadrilateral has opposite sides equal but adjacent sides not necessarily equal?
mcqs.explanation: A parallelogram is defined by having both pairs of opposite sides equal and parallel; the adjacent sides can be of different lengths. A square and rhombus have all sides equal, while a rectangle has opposite sides equal and all angles right. Hence only option D fits the description.

mcqs.question: If a quadrilateral has all interior angles equal to 90°, which type of quadrilateral is it classified as based only on its angle property?
mcqs.explanation: Having all interior angles equal to 90° makes the quadrilateral a rectangle. While a square also has right angles, the classification that relies solely on angle property (right angles) is rectangle. Option B is therefore correct. Options A and C add side-length conditions, and D does not require right angles.

mcqs.learning_point: Recognise squares, rectangles, parallelograms, rhombi and trapezia
mcqs.question: Which of the following figures is a trapezium (trapezoid) according to the definition used in class 8 mathematics?

options.A: A quadrilateral with exactly one pair of parallel sides
options.B: A quadrilateral with both pairs of opposite sides parallel
options.C: A quadrilateral with all four sides equal
options.D: A quadrilateral with all interior angles equal to 90°

mcqs.answer: A quadrilateral with exactly one pair of parallel sides
mcqs.explanation: A trapezium (or trapezoid) is defined as a quadrilateral that has only one pair of opposite sides parallel. Option A matches this definition. Option B describes a parallelogram, C a rhombus/square, and D a rectangle/square.

mcqs.learning_point: Understand relationships among different quadrilateral classes
mcqs.question: All squares are rectangles, but not all rectangles are squares. Which statement correctly expresses this relationship?

options.A: The set of squares is a subset of the set of rectangles.
options.B: The set of rectangles is a subset of the set of squares.
options.C: Squares and rectangles are disjoint sets.
options.D: The set of squares is a subset of the set of rhombuses only.

mcqs.answer: The set of squares is a subset of the set of rectangles.
mcqs.explanation: Every square satisfies the definition of a rectangle (four right angles) while also having equal sides. Therefore, every square belongs to the rectangle family, making squares a subset of rectangles. Option A states this correctly. Options B and C are false, and D is incomplete.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements is NOT true about quadrilaterals?

options.B: The sum of their interior angles is 360 degrees.
options.C: All quadrilaterals have four equal sides.

mcqs.answer: All quadrilaterals have four equal sides.
mcqs.explanation: Only specific quadrilaterals like squares and rhombuses have four equal sides. General quadrilaterals can have sides of different lengths, so statement C is false. Statements A, B, and D are true for every quadrilateral.

mcqs.learning_point: Identify sides, vertices and angles of quadrilaterals
mcqs.question: A figure has exactly 4 sides, 4 vertices, and 4 interior angles. Which of the following must be true?

options.B: The figure must be a square.
options.C: The figure must be a rectangle.
options.D: The figure must be a rhombus.

mcqs.explanation: The definition of a quadrilateral is a polygon with four sides, four vertices, and four interior angles. Therefore, any figure meeting these counts is a quadrilateral, regardless of side lengths or angle measures. Options B, C, and D add extra conditions that are not guaranteed.
